decisions.reason: The naval lighting line is a niche option with limited website presence, but its prospects remain uncertain and the carrying cost is still low enough to retain the option.
The desk lamp has a dedicated page, indicating ongoing commitment, and its option value still exceeds the low cost of keeping it while uncertainty resolves.
As a core general interior luminaire with its own page, it has broad market fit and is a low-cost option to retain.
As the flagship microprismatic pendant, it is central to the firm's stated direction and warrants continued investment.
The marine HMI searchlight is a narrow, specialized option with no dedicated page, and given many other options its carrying cost likely outweighs the unresolved upside.
A standard marine searchlight is peripheral and equally unsupported by web presence, so its option has likely resolved unfavorably and resources are better redeployed.
